paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Paragraph retrieval ratios 0.90\% of LLMs. The majority of LLMs can be classified as either conservative (ratio<300.90{%}) or open retrievers (ratio>380.90{%}).

model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the Retrieval Ratio (%) for an expert and various large language models. The horizontal axis displays the categories, representing the different entities evaluated, with their text labels rotated diagonally. The categories are not sorted in a specific ascending, descending, or alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents the data value, labeled "Retrieval Ratio (%)" in bold, and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50 with tick marks at intervals of 10 units. Light gray grid lines intersect the chart horizontally at each tick mark and vertically between each category. Each category is represented by a single, distinctively colored vertical bar with its exact numerical value annotated directly above it. From left to right, the bars correspond to Expert (dark gray, 34.11), GPT-4o (muted teal, 29.07), GPT-4-turbo (purplish-gray, 29.16), GPT-4o-mini (slate blue, 43.57), Claude 3 Opus (mauve, 25.92), Claude 3.5 Sonnet (blue-gray, 31.56), Claude 3.5 Haiku (pale brown, 28.49), Gemini 1.5 Pro (light blue, 39.37), Llama-3.1-405B (pale lavender, 37.99), Mistral Large (beige, 31.04), DeepSeek-V3 (light gray, 46.94), Qwen-Max (pale khaki, 34.84), and GLM-4-Plus (pale pink, 43.58). The tallest bar is DeepSeek-V3 at 46.94, while the shortest bar is Claude 3 Opus at 25.92. The chart consists only of individual bars and does not contain grouped or stacked elements. Visually, the category label "Expert" on the horizontal axis is uniquely emphasized in bold, dark red text, distinguishing it from the remaining black labels.
model_annotations.German: This vertical bar chart illustrates the paragraph retrieval ratios for an expert baseline and twelve different large language models. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing the evaluated entities with labels rotated diagonally, though it lacks an overall axis label. The categories are not sorted in numerical or alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Retrieval Ratio (%)", and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50 with regular tick intervals of 10. Light gray horizontal and vertical grid lines are visible in the background. Each category is represented by a single, solid-colored bar with its exact percentage value annotated directly above it. From left to right, the categories, colors, and values are: "Expert" in dark gray (34.11), "GPT-4o" in muted teal (29.07), "GPT-4-turbo" in purplish-gray (29.16), "GPT-4o-mini" in steel blue (43.57), "Claude 3 Opus" in dusty rose (25.92), "Claude 3.5 Sonnet" in light grayish-blue (31.56), "Claude 3.5 Haiku" in brownish-pink (28.49), "Gemini 1.5 Pro" in light blue (39.37), "Llama-3.1-405B" in light purple (37.99), "Mistral Large" in beige (31.04), "DeepSeek-V3" in light gray (46.94), "Qwen-Max" in pale greenish-beige (34.84), and "GLM-4-Plus" in very light pink (43.58). The tallest bar is "DeepSeek-V3" at 46.94, while the shortest bar is "Claude 3 Opus" at 25.92. Notably, the horizontal axis label for "Expert" is visually emphasized, appearing in bold, dark red text, whereas all other category labels are in standard black text.
